headline: Bulog Holds Cheap Food Movement Events During Car Free Day Nationally
seoTitle: Bulog Holds Cheap Food Movement at Car Free Day
metaDescription: The Indonesian logistics agency Bulog is hosting affordable food market events at Car Free Day locations across the country to stabilize local prices.
aiSummaryBullets: Perum Bulog is conducting the Cheap Food Movement across Indonesia during Car Free Day events.
The initiative aims to provide affordable food access and stabilize rice prices for the public.
The agency is coordinating with the National Food Agency to accelerate aid distribution to over 33 million families.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian logistics agency Perum Bulog, in collaboration with the National Food Agency (Bapanas), has launched the Cheap Food Movement (Gerakan Pangan Murah). This national initiative is primarily held during Car Free Day events to improve public access to essential food items, specifically targeting rice price stability. Beyond these market events, Bulog and Bapanas are working to accelerate the distribution of food assistance to 33.2 million families nationwide. This program serves as part of a broader government effort to ensure food availability and maintain social protection for vulnerable populations across the country. The events held in locations such as Makassar reflect a broader strategy to synchronize food supply management and distribution logistics at the regional level, ensuring that subsidized commodities reach the target demographic effectively while mitigating potential market price volatility in local economies.
whyItIsViral: The event is gaining attention due to synchronized national reporting across major Indonesian media outlets focusing on public food security initiatives.
